subject: Game Theory
title: Why Auctions Work
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Why Auctions Work.

hook.text: A seller has a painting but no idea what it's worth. Two bidders both want it. An auction solves this.

buildup.text: Competition between bidders drives the price toward the item's true market value.

discovery.text: Auctions work because they harness private information. Each bidder reveals their value through bids.

twist.text: But bidders don't bid their true value—they shade bids lower to maximize profit if they win.

climax.text: The auction's design determines how much truth bidders reveal and how much revenue sellers earn.

quiz.question: Why do bidders typically bid below their true value?
options: To maximize profit if they win
